purpose: Integrate operator-supplied historical Tennis-Data Match Winner prices into private BlinQ canonical history, preserve full bookmaker context in a sidecar, and publish a validated ATP player-profile research sidecar.
source_policy: public pinned mirrors are used only as deterministic transport and must match the exact operator-provided file SHA-256
duplicate_policy: df_atp.csv.zip is byte-identical to archive df_atp.csv and is intentionally not imported twice; enriched ATP 2007-2019 odds overlap archive ATP and are used only for profile context, while only 2020-2022 odds are added from the enriched file.
orientation_policy: Winner/Loser source orientation is used only for identity linking; every persisted quote is canonical player1/player2
player_profile_policy: country/hand/year_pro/height/weight are range-validated, identity-linked to canonical player IDs, conflicting fields are dropped, and the result remains research-only pending ablation
redundant_fields_policy: WPts/LPts are not promoted because BlinQ already has stronger point-in-time ATP/WTA ranking-history sources; post-match set scores are not introduced as same-match features
model_feature_policy: odds benchmark-only; player profile research-only; no automatic model promotion
